question: lisbon POI count by category having >500
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: lisbon open share per POI category
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN operating_status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_cnt, AVG(CASE WHEN operating_status = 'open' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS open_share FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category ORDER BY total DESC

question: top 3 POI categories per locality lisbon
sql: WITH locality_counts AS (SELECT addr.locality AS locality, p.basic_category AS basic_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places p, UNNEST(p.addresses) AS t(addr) WHERE addr.locality IS NOT NULL GROUP BY addr.locality, p.basic_category) SELECT locality, basic_category, cnt FROM locality_counts QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY locality ORDER BY cnt DESC) <= 3 ORDER BY locality, cnt DESC

question: lisbon places confidence buckets distribution
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.9 THEN 'high (0.9-1.0)' WHEN confidence >= 0.7 THEN 'medium (0.7-0.9)' WHEN confidence >= 0.5 THEN 'low (0.5-0.7)' ELSE 'very low (<0.5)' END AS confidence_bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY confidence_bucket ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: branded chain vs independent POI counts by category lisbon
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN brand['wikidata'] IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS branded_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN brand['wikidata'] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS independent_cnt, AVG(CASE WHEN brand['wikidata'] IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS branded_share FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY branded_cnt DESC

question: lisbon POI website presence rate by taxonomy
sql: SELECT taxonomy['primary'] AS taxonomy_primary, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN websites IS NOT NULL AND len(websites) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_website, AVG(CASE WHEN websites IS NOT NULL AND len(websites) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS website_share FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY taxonomy['primary'] HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 ORDER BY website_share DESC
